svg.title: Peri-event pupil responses across P3 modalities
svg.desc: Panel A shows population mean event-minus-control pupil traces for each modality, cohort, context, and mismatch event. Panel B shows mouse-level response-window effects with bootstrap confidence intervals. SLAP2 duration is unavailable because too few trials pass pupil tracking quality control.
svg.text: Context event minus matched control; orientation angles are pooled in the static summary
Mean event-minus-control pupil change during each defined response window; bars show 95% mouse-bootstrap intervals
Pupil area is expressed as within-trial percent change from the context-specific preceding interval; all events align to display-synchronized NWB start_time.
